readout.matching_epsilon_status: Necessary target-matching equality, explicitly not a source selection of the physical contact strength.
readout.scope: Canonical level-one lattice current algebra, fixed charged pair and its free-boson Ward identity. A defect sector sum or a different physical seam response may differ and must be selected by the original source.

flow.scope: Native finite transfer with rates selected from its target spectrum, not a derived universal RG. The QCD beta test is restricted to the declared SM one-loop coefficient; no two-loop crossing scale was reproduced.

deck.scope: The existing NS/bounding spin lift on Cl16. Geometric sheets, these Fock parity sectors, and D5/A3 chirality modules require separate explicit identifications; no identification is assumed.

excluded: The carrier 5/4 two-point exponent automatically remains in the normalized/connected U(1) current response of one canonical fixed charged sector.
The native v486 transfer has two independent stationary modes corresponding to c3 and phi_base.
The archived QCD crossings are zeros of the declared one-loop QCD beta function.
The native v506 NS Fock deck lift exchanges its two fermion-parity sectors and hence fixes a relative Hamiltonian offset by that exchange.
first_missing_original_choice: A common source-selected charged seam state, observable/defect measure and time action. These must precede interpreting the relative 4/3 factor and carrier 5/4 exponent as physical alpha data.
firewall: Internal exact structural tests, not empirical evidence and not promotion of a physical TFPT claim.
